meta_description:
1M likes, 3,107 comments - pewdiepie on May 10, 2025: "Never thought I'd be raising a kid with four dogs… in a foreign country, too! You’re the reason this family feels so full of love and just the right amount of madness.

Every "crazy" thing we’ve done together has made life richer and better. You make me brave to want more - but you've also kept me grounded, even when I didn’t deserve it. I see how you show up every day with so much love no matter what. And now, watching you with Björn, I see it all again. From the way he lights up every time you enter the room, to the quiet moments of you reading books together.

You’re the best mom he could ever have and were both so lucky to be loved by you.

Happy Mother’s Day 👧❤️🧔🐻🐶🐶🐶🐶".
